payload.entry: force_parser done. New src/native/highlights_ref/force.rs: ForceMode::{Reread,Overwrite}, spec'd clap arg (num_args 0..=1, require_equals, default_missing reread, possible values, ignore_case), after-only adoption via clap indices with bareness read from raw argv (bare and --force= are index-identical in clap 4.6.7: flag slot + one value slot), stray-mode guard (exact or edit distance <=2, escapes ./x [[x] existing-path URL), missing-target re-parse for byte-identical usage error. Option<ForceMode> through CreateOptions/ClipOptions/collection; low-level bool perms via is_some(); unrelated commands' force flags untouched. Overwrite triage: filed refs exit 2 '-f overwrite is not available yet for filed references'; fresh sources exit 1 'nothing to overwrite: <source> is not a reference yet' + hint; queued-only/exact-output/audio keep old perms; -L attach preserved. Help: -f row + Recapture section (honest interim limits); completion automatic via clap choices (group mode, !prefix 8). Verified: 14 force unit tests (full matrix), 13 new CLI tests (guard/adoption/missing-target/repeat/invalid/fresh/filed/queued/clip-alias/glued/collection + no-fetch no-adapter no-write proofs), full highlights lib 751 + CLI 399 + completion/help/docs 146 + ref_library/aliases 185 all green; cargo fmt clean; clippy gate 0 errors; just docs-gen + docs-check pass (ref.md golden unchanged: member help not captured). Deviation from matrix: '-foverwrite URL' is NOT clap UnknownArgument — '-o' owns short o so it parses as '-f -o verwrite' and fails on the output-path extension (verified byte-identical to spaced form); help documents this and a test locks it.
